Item.Name: ABO_RESULT
Item.Hint: Enter prior ABORH test result or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 null_value VARCHAR2(1):='';
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select 'Y' into :GLOBAL.auto_unit
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 donor_decision_code = 'S';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.auto_unit := 'N';
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in checking for AUTO unit');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 update units
 set donor_lab_dats = sysdate,
 prior_abo = :abo_result,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in trying to update unit');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :GLOBAL.auto_unit = 'N' and :s_permanent_assertion = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, inter_code,
 insert_dats, inter_user_id, program_id)
 values (:unit_id, :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, 'DMIP',
 sysdate, :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in trying to put DMIP');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
/*
 if :GLOBAL.auto_unit = 'N' and :s_temporary_assertion = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, inter_code,
 insert_dats, inter_user_id, program_id)
 values (:unit_id, :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, 'DMIT',
 sysdate, :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in trying to put DMIP');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
*/
 if :abo_result is not null
 then
 begin
 --
 -- Calling database procedure for test discrepancy
 --
 :GLOBAL.return_val := test_results.discrepancy(
 :unit_id,
 :coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'ABORH',
 :abo_result,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message(:GLOBAL.return_val);
 message
 ('CORE routine for test results not run successfully');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 begin
 insert into donor_tested_units
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, test_id,
 result_status, insert_dats)
 values (:unit_id, :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'ABORH', :abo_result, sysdate);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in trying to put in donor tested');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :system.cursor_value is not null
 then
 begin
 select result_status, code_desc
 into :abo_result, :s_abo_desc
 from valid_test_results, master_codes
 where test_id = 'ABORH' and
 result_status = :abo_result and
 code = result_status and
 code_type = 'RESUL' and
 sysdate between valid_test_results.eff_date and
 nvl(valid_test_results.term_date,sysdate) and
 sysdate between master_codes.eff_date and
 nvl(master_codes.term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1140');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in checking from valid_test_results');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;
